title: Sri Lanka sites
note: Claude's first guess, for Shahar to correct. No pitch carries an amount until the numbers are decided; then they go into the writer's custom.md via a proposal. Inbound one-off clients get no price on the pitch.

offers.name: Managed
offers.buys: We host it, they edit it: Cloudflare Worker, SSL, CMS login for their site only, nightly backups (30 days), rebuild on every save, uptime and updates ours. Up to 30 min of our edits a month. Static zip on exit, no lock-in.

offers.name: Self-hosted Docker
offers.recurring: 0 to us; ~6–12 / month to their VPS host
offers.buys: Payload + Postgres + builder + Caddy on their own server; we install, verify, hand over the credentials and revoke our access. Support after handoff: 40 / hour.

offers.name: Static only
offers.buys: Static build + source zip, runs on any host. Only if the owner will never edit.

offers.name: Domain
offers.buys: Cloudflare Registrar at cost (~10–11 / year for .com) plus renewal handling and DNS. .lk is not on Cloudflare Registrar: check before pitching one.

upsells.name: Second language
upsells.note: Full copy pipeline in that language, reviewed like English

upsells.name: Email on their domain
upsells.note: Cloudflare Email Routing to their Gmail; a real mailbox is pass-through

upsells.name: Google Business Profile tune-up
upsells.note: Hours, categories, photos, link to the new site, reply templates

upsells.name: Review QR cards
upsells.note: Print-ready PDF that opens their Google review form

upsells.name: Photo shoot
upsells.note: Only when we are on site (live mode)

upsells.name: We do the edits
upsells.note: Up to 4 content changes a month, same day

upsells.name: SEO + AI SEO refresh
upsells.note: Stations 4h–4i re-run on the live content, with a report

upsells.name: Seasonal / campaign page
upsells.note: One extra page on the same template

costs.note: Check the free-plan request limit against real traffic before promising it
2 M-token budget at API list rates; not tracked; flat if on a subscription
